claim:
For every \(0<w<1\), let \(X_w=(\mathbb R^2,N_w)\) be the real two-dimensional Lorentz-predual plane with
\[
N_w(u,v)=\max\left\{|u|,|v|,\frac{|u|+|v|}{1+w}\right\}.
\]
Its classical Joly rectangular constant
\[
\mu(X_w)=\sup_{\substack{x,y\in S_{X_w},\ x\perp_B y\\ t\ge0}}
\frac{1+t}{N_w(x+t y)}
\]
has the exact phase diagram
\[
\mu(X_w)=1+2\max\left\{w,\frac{1-w}{1+w}\right\}
=\begin{cases}
\dfrac{3-w}{1+w},&0<w\le\sqrt2-1,\\[2mm]
1+2w,&\sqrt2-1\le w<1.
\end{cases}
\]
Consequently the unique parameter minimizing \(\mu(X_w)\) is \(w=\sqrt2-1\), the Euclidean-regular octagonal member, and the minimum is \(2\sqrt2-1\). Complete normalized maximizing triples \((x,y,t)\) are as follows, up to a common signed-coordinate permutation. If \(0<w<\sqrt2-1\), the only type is
\[
x=(1,w),\quad y=\left(-\frac{1+w}{2},\frac{1+w}{2}\right),\quad t=\frac{2(1-w)}{1+w}.
\]
If \(\sqrt2-1<w<1\), the only type is
\[
x=(1,w),\quad y=(0,-1),\quad t=2w.
\]
At \(w=\sqrt2-1\) both displayed types maximize; these are the only two types under signed-coordinate permutations. Hence the maximizing mechanism switches from a slanted facet to an axial facet exactly at the regular-octagon threshold.

correctness.rationale: The unit sphere is partitioned exhaustively into interiors of axial edges, interiors of slanted edges, and the eight vertices. The first two have strict upper bounds below the respective facet-orbit values. At a vertex, the Birkhoff–James supporting cone is exactly the union of directions (-a,b) and (a,-b) with b>=a, 0<=a<=c/2 and b=1 for a<=w or b=c-a afterward. For either sign the max of two affine lower bounds on the denominator produces a unimodal sharp envelope, attained at their intersection. Exact formulas R_+(a)=(a+wb+1-w²)/(wa+b) and R_-(a)=1+2w(1-a)/(b+wa) are strictly increasing and strictly decreasing, respectively. Their endpoints yield 1+2(1-w)/(1+w) and 1+2w, with unique normalized equality configurations. An independent symbolic algebra check reproduces all four derivative signs and exact endpoint vectors; sampled numerical stress tests play no proof role.
risks: Only real two-dimensional spaces, 0<w<1, and exact normalized maximizers are classified.
The two maximizing orbit representatives at the regular octagon are distinct only under the stated signed-coordinate subgroup; additional full regular-octagon isometries may identify them.

value.rationale: This is a complete and natural one-parameter phase diagram for Joly’s classical rectangular constant on the standard two-dimensional Lorentz-predual octagonal family, rather than an arbitrary finite table or a known-number substitution. It characterizes all ordered maximizing triples and proves that the regular Euclidean octagon is the unique family member minimizing a Birkhoff–James orthogonality distortion; the competing facet-edge mechanisms exchange optimality precisely at w=sqrt(2)-1. The fact that the same threshold organizes independently studied Banach–Mazur geometry and bilinear-form cases makes this complete boundary geometrically motivated without confusing their invariant definitions.
risks: The theorem is confined to two dimensions and does not generalize automatically to arbitrary finite-dimensional Lorentz preduals.
An eventual general formula for all polygonal norms could subsume the computational method, but none was located or used in the checked complete primary sources.
